svg.title: Floor Plan: the sheet
svg.desc: The Floor Plan page: a cyanotype sheet with a tray of empty stamp slots at the left, the outside wall measured along the top at 120 paces, the ground floor ruled in white from memory with its east end refusing to close, a compass rose and scale bar, and remembered paces pencilled down the margin.
svg.text: FLOOR PLAN / GROUND / DRAWN FROM MEMORY
